entities.summary: Guerschon Yabusele is a French professional basketball player for the Chicago Bulls of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He primarily plays at the power forward position. Yabusele represents the French national team in international competitions, with whom he won silver medals at the 2020 and 2024 Olympics.
